learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 27 products on one Webflow page (NY-only brand, OCM processor license on the site).
notes: One server-rendered Webflow collection list; each product is a div.collection-item-main.w-dyn-item with the name in an h2 and Finsweet fields (fs-list-field category, type, thc, cbd, price). The hidden price field is not reliable (the same 1g pre-roll is 21 or 5).

Moonrock and infused pre-roll titles state the format; flower and single pre-roll titles do not state a size ('No Cap Flower'), but their images are named with it ('GG - 3.5g - Flower - No Cap.png', 'GG - 1g - Pre-roll - No Cap.png'), so the size is read from the image URL (body). London Poundcake Flower's newer image has no size; every other jar is 3.5g and 6 NY stores sell it as 3.5g, so a flower image without a size falls back to 3.5g.
The 3-Pack Live Resin Infused Pre-Rolls never state a per-roll weight on the site; NY stores sell them as '1.2g | 3 pack | 3.6g', so they are set to 3 x 1.2g.
Zero Gravity is the moonrock line (the site banner: 'Zero Gravity Moon Rocks have landed'); moonrock is flower with the subtype infused.
